note_scale: Raw L_DTI ~7.7e-4 makes user lambdas inert without /dti_ref_scale. Even after scaling, signal gradients dominate until lambda_DTI >= ~5000.

Q1_mixed_relieves_conflict.detail: User λ∈[0,10] remains signal-dominated (FA worsens like Phase5-A). Only λ≳5000 improves FA/D_err, but then PSNR collapses below z=0. Soft mixing does not yield a useful middle ground vs z=0.

Q2_exists_lambda_both_better_than_z0.detail: No tested (λ_DTI, λ_z) simultaneously achieves PSNR>z0 and FA_MAE<z0.

Q3_phase5_dti_z_runaway.detail: Exceeds 1.5× train mean. High-λ mixed optima land at ||z||≈0.57–0.73 (near train scale), so pure DTI-oracle runaway is partly objective-driven, not strictly required for modest FA gains.

Q4_norm_reg_helps.detail: On user λ grid, λ_z has negligible effect. On FA-improving high λ (5e3/1e4), λ_z∈{0.01,0.1,1} barely changes ||z||/PSNR/FA — does not restore signal while keeping DTI gains.

Q5_pareto_compromise.detail: Clear PSNR↔FA trade-off along λ. No point dominates z=0 on both metrics. Continue v1; next research unsupervised/signal-observable identifiable adaptation (not WLS-mixed formal protocol).

Q6_discuss_v2_now.detail: Oracle still shows DTI capability (Phase5-B / high-λ). Failure is objective/identifiability under signal+WLS mixing, not proven architecture incapability. Do not enter v2 yet.

Go_NoGo_Population_DTI_INR_v1: HOLD_v1 — keep architecture; mixed WLS objective is diagnostic-only and does not yield simultaneous signal+DTI win vs z=0; next: unsupervised / signal-observable adaptation research. NO immediate v2.
